item.title: Morrissey Cancels Las Vegas Residency Shows Days Before Opening Night
item.description:
Here is a short, engaging podcast script based on the provided article:
**[Intro music]**
Host: Welcome back to our music update. We've got some disappointing news for Morrissey fans. His upcoming Las Vegas residency has been canceled.
**[Transition music]**
Host: According to Rolling Stone, ticket buyers were informed on Friday that the four-night run at Wynn Las Vegas' Encore Theater, set to begin on August 14, was canceled due to "unforeseen logistical issues." The news was confirmed via email, which stated that the scheduled residency cannot take place.
Host: This isn't the first time Morrissey has canceled or rescheduled shows. In fact, he has a history of calling off performances for various reasons. Just last year, he canceled 25 shows and postponed 11. And earlier this year, he canceled a pair of California dates due to a medical issue, as well as a show in Spain citing "sleep deprivation."
**[Music clip: Morrissey]**
Host: Despite the cancellation, Morrissey still has a packed schedule ahead. He's set to perform at Chicago's Riot Fest on September 19, Brooklyn's CBGB Festival on September 26, and will headline the Darker Waves Festival in Huntington Beach, California on November 14.
Host: Morrissey's last live performance was just a few days ago, on August 1, at the Super Bock Arena in Porto, Portugal. And, of course, he recently released his 14th studio album, "Make-Up Is a Lie," in March.
**[Outro music]**
Host: That's all for now. We'll keep an eye on Morrissey's schedule and let you know if there are any further updates. Thanks for tuning in!
